title: AgentAction
description: One complete decision cycle, persisted. This is the audit trail AND the demo: the dApp feed renders these as 'data consulted → reasoning → transaction'. Recorded even when the agent holds or fails, because a curator that did nothing and said why is still curating.

status.description: 'rejected' = the model's output failed schema or mandate-constraint validation and never reached the chain. Keep these: they are evidence the validation layer is load-bearing.

snapshot.description: Exactly what the agent could see. Stored whole so a decision is reproducible after the fact.

mandate_version_after.description: Differs from _before only when the agent amended its own mandate this tick.

validation_retries.description: How many malformed outputs were rejected before a valid one. Worth surfacing — it is the honest cost of small open models.

warnings.description: Constraints this cycle breached and was ACCEPTED anyway, within Mandate.constraints.tolerance_band_pct. Distinct from `error`, which is why a cycle stopped: a warning rides on a successful action. MUST be rendered wherever the action is — an in-band acceptance that is invisible in the feed is indistinguishable from there being no rule at all, and repeated silent acceptances are how a book ratchets away from its mandate without ever tripping a rejection.

constraint_warning.description: One banded acceptance, structured so the dApp can state which constraint bent and by how much rather than re-parsing a sentence.

kind.description: Closed on purpose. A second warning class is a schema change, so nobody can quietly start recording a different kind of exception in the same array.

constraint.description: The MandateConstraints field that bent, or 'target_allocation' for drift. Never max_slippage_bps or an allowlist — those are outside the band by design.

subject.description: Asset symbol, when the constraint is per-asset. Absent for portfolio-wide ones.

limit.description: The mandate's own value for that constraint — the number the band is measured relative to, and the number the agent is still steering back toward.

actual.description: The projected post-execution value that breached the limit.

band_pct.description: The tolerance_band_pct in force when this was accepted. Recorded on the action rather than looked up later, because the mandate is mutable by the agent and a warning must stay readable against the rules that actually applied.

message.description: One sentence for the feed, e.g. 'WETH at 61.2% against a 60% cap — accepted inside the 5% tolerance band'.
